title: Revert Engine Fix
headline: This release fixes the trial expiry revert so slider and preset tweaks actually reset to true Windows defaults.
changes: Fixed: Slider tweaks now revert to their real Windows default values on trial expiry, not the corrupted backup that matched the tweaked value. Same fix applied to preset tweaks (IRQ, I/O, GPU profiles).
Fixed: The 'teams-startup' toggle tweak no longer fails to revert. The PowerShell command had broken quoting that caused a 'positional parameter' error.
Improved: After a trial expiry revert, the stale state file entries are cleared. The next time you apply a premium tweak, it will capture a fresh true original value.
